description: This file defines the `VisitSearchCriteria` class, which encapsulates various filtering parameters used for querying visits within the OpenMRS system. It includes fields for visit types, patients, locations, indications, date ranges, attributes, and flags to include or exclude inactive and voided visits.

classes.name: VisitSearchCriteria
classes.description: Represents criteria used for searching and filtering visits based on various parameters such as type, patient, location, date range, etc.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Returns the collection of visit types included in the search criteria.

methods.name: setVisitTypes
methods.description: Sets the collection of visit types to be included in the search criteria.

methods.name: getPatients
methods.description: Returns the collection of patients included in the search criteria.

methods.name: setPatients
methods.description: Sets the collection of patients to be included in the search criteria.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Returns the collection of locations included in the search criteria.

methods.name: setLocations
methods.description: Sets the collection of locations to be included in the search criteria.

methods.name: getIndications
methods.description: Returns the collection of indications (Concepts) included in the search criteria.

methods.name: setIndications
methods.description: Sets the collection of indications for the search.

methods.name: getMinStartDatetime
methods.description: Returns the minimum start date/time for the search.

methods.name: setMinStartDatetime
methods.description: Sets the minimum start date/time for the search.

methods.name: getMaxStartDatetime
methods.description: Returns the maximum start date/time for the search.

methods.name: setMaxStartDatetime
methods.description: Sets the maximum start date/time for the search.

methods.name: getMinEndDatetime
methods.description: Returns the minimum end date/time for the search.

methods.name: setMinEndDatetime
methods.description: Sets the minimum end date/time for the search.

methods.name: getMaxEndDatetime
methods.description: Returns the maximum end date/time for the search.

methods.name: setMaxEndDatetime
methods.description: Sets the maximum end date/time for the search.

methods.name: getSerializedAttributeValues
methods.description: Returns the map of serialized attribute values used to filter visits.

methods.name: setSerializedAttributeValues
methods.description: Sets the map of serialized attribute values for filtering.

methods.name: isIncludeInactive
methods.description: Indicates whether inactive visits are included.

methods.name: setIncludeInactive
methods.description: Sets whether to include inactive visits.

methods.name: isIncludeVoided
methods.description: Indicates whether voided visits are included.

methods.name: setIncludeVoided
methods.description: Sets whether to include voided visits.
